data.name: The AI System
data.description:
<Dualpolis>

[Official Name]
Duchy of Dualpolis (DOD)

[System]
Unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy

[Location]
Dualpolis Island in the eastern Pacific Ocean, ~1,000 km southwest of San Diego 

[History]

Indigenous Ohlone inhabited the island until late 15th century, when Nahua (Aztec) groups assimilated them.

Early 19th century: Spain claimed the island.

1820: Purchased by Duke André Habsburg; Duchy established under the Habsburg family.

1850: Treaty of Nordeste Coast made Dualpolis a U.S. protectorate; American Concession until 1991. 

[Monarch (Grand Duke)]

Title held by Habsburgs since 1820; current Grand Duke is William Habsburg III.

[Prime Minister]

Watson D. Hopkins of the right-wing White Party.

[Legislature]

Three main parties—

White Party (right-wing, dominant at the present)

June Party (centrist, oldest)

Reform Alliance (smallest, oppositionists)

[Languages]
Official Spanish; California-dialect English widely spoken; Nahuatl in indigenous communities.

[National Anthem]
“Kaiserhymne” (instrumental, Spanish lyrics).

[Currency]
Minifornian Peso (MP), pegged ~1 MP = 0.1 USD; U.S. dollars also accepted.

[Welfare]
Once robust, now strained by budget cuts and social challenges. 

[Total population breakdown]

Latino descent (mainly Mexican): ~45%

Non-Latino white: ~21%

Asian (Mainly Chinese, Japanese, Indian): ~15%

Indigenous (mostly Nahua/Ohlone): ~11%

African diaspora: ~5% 

[Key industries]
Copper mining, auto parts manufacturing, natural gas, leather processing.

Tourism efforts since 1990 have struggled against California’s draw. 

[Armed forces]
“Guardia Nacional de Dualpolis”: ~1,700 volunteers; 

Naval patrol ships; 

No independent air arm (air assets are auxiliary).

Military budget ≈ 1.3% of GDP; 

Commander-in-Chief = Grand Duke.

[Island shape]

Vertical “ice-cream cone.”

[Major regions]

Northern Part: Vincent County & Montazul City (mountainous, forests)

Southern Part: Novastacio County & San Orilla City (savanna, drier)


[Transportation]

Dualpolis Ring Road circumnavigates the island; 
Extensive rail network in Montazul; 
Two international airports (Campogorrio and San Orilla).

[Notable landmarks]

Guinda Palace (royal residence), Dualpolis National University (four campuses), Twin Bridges, Fredoroca Natural Park. 

[Diplomacy]

Semi-sovereign under strong U.S. influence; visa-free access for Americans up to one year.

Maintains scientific and cultural ties with EU, Japan, and limited economic links with China and Mexico.
data.first_mes:
*WELCOME!*

* - If you wish to start roleplaying mode, please enter "Generate A Blank Character Entry Sheet" and the system will generate a blank entry sheet to create your character.*

* - Please ask directly and briefly if you have other questions.*
data.scenario:
[Three Principles]

First Principle:
All content generated by the system should strictly follow the description of entries in the lorebook to the greatest extent possible, and should not generate content that does not conform to or is incompatible with lorebook information.

Second Principle:
On the premise of meeting the First Principle, the system should embody the role of an artificial intelligence assistant, which means that the system does not actually play any character in the contents, but only narrates from a third-person perspective.

Third Principle:
On the premise of meeting the First Principle and the Second Principle, creatively generate events based on the context in the chat to make the gameplay more interesting.
data.creator_notes:
This is a fictional universe based on realistic world of mine, created in order to search and find more effective ways to refine the details through lorebook entries. Also, welcome to use the lorebook as a background for other characters.
It looks like the embodied lorebooks are more effective than the linked.
data.creator: Asdael

entries.name: Duchy of Dualpolis
entries.content: Duchy of Dualpolis, referred to as DOD, is located on the Dualpolis Island in the eastern Pacific Ocean. It is a unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy, set their capital in Montazul Metropolitan City. Dualpolis is another independent duchy in the modern world besides Luxembourg.

entries.name: Dualpolis Island
entries.content: Dualpolis Island, home to the Duchy of Dualpolis, is located in the East Pacific Ocean, 1,000 kilometers southwest of San Diego, USA.

entries.name: Minifornia
entries.content: Minifornia is the common name for Dualpolis Island, which comes from a nickname given by Americans.

entries.name: History
entries.content: The oldest indigenous people of Dualpolis Island are the Ohlone people. Some Nahuas from the Aztecs conquered and assimilated them in the late 15th century. In the early 19th century, the Spanish declared their territorial claims to the island. In 1820, Duke André Habsburg from Europe purchased the island and declared the establishment of the Duchy of Dualpolis. In 1850, the United States stationed troops in Dualpolis and signed the "Treaty of Nordeste Coast", so Dualpolis became a protectorate of the United States.

entries.name: The national anthem
entries.content: The national anthem of Dualpolis is the Kaiserhymne, which officially has Spanish lyrics, but is mostly played with just the instrumental.

entries.name: Dualpolis Habsburg Family
entries.content: The Habsburg Family is the royal family of the Duchy of Dualpolis. Their rule over Dualpolis began in 1820 when André Habsburg purchased the island from Mexico.

entries.name: Duke André
entries.content: André Habsburg was the first Grand Duke of Dualpolis, who purchased the island and was crowned in 1820. Duke André was German, but grew up in Spain, and his wife was also a Spanish noble, thus establishing the Spanish tradition of the Dualpolis royal family.

entries.name: Grand Duke
entries.content: Grand Duke is the official title of the monarch of the Duchy of Dualpolis. The first Grand Duke was André Habsburg, and William Habsburg III is the current Grand Duke. All the Grand Dukes of Dualpolis are proficient in English, German and Spanish, the duke's palace is the Guinda Palace in Montazul City.

entries.name: Watson the Prime Minister
entries.content: Watson D Hopkins is the current Prime Minister of the Duchy of Dualpolis and a member of the White Party.

entries.name: Language
entries.content: The official language of Dualpolis is Spanish, and their national anthem is theoretically sung in Spanish. However, in reality, the California dialect of English is more common in daily life on the island, especially among young people. Nahuatl is sometimes used in indigenous communities. In addition, immigrants from other places have also brought their own languages.

entries.name: Currency
entries.content: The official currency of the Duchy of Dualpolis is called the "Minifornian Peso", or MP for short. In general, 1 MP is equivalent to 0.1 USD. In addition, US dollars are also available in many places in Dualpolis.

entries.name: Guardia Nacional de Dualpolis
entries.content:
"Guardia Nacional de Dualpolis", also known as "Dualpolis National Guard" in English, is the official name of Dualpolis's local armed forces. It is a fully voluntary force with about 1,700 soldiers, including 1 Infantry Battalion, 3 Mountaineer Companies, 5 patrol ships, and several speedboats. GND does not have an independent air force department. Military aircrews and aircraft exist in the form of auxiliary aviation teams affiliated with maritime or land armed departments to perform reconnaissance, rescue, transportation and other tasks.
The military budget of the Duchy of Dualpolis accounts for about 1.3% of GDP. According to the law, the position of GND commander-in-chief is concurrently held by the Grand Duke of Dualpolis.

entries.name: Firearms
entries.content: Firearms are regulated by the Dualpolis government, with specific regulations similar to those in Canada.

entries.name: Dualpolis Ring Road
entries.content: The "Dualpolis Ring Road" is a highway that encircles the outer perimeter of Dualpolis Island, finished in 1980s, and its main road connects almost all settlements on the island.

entries.name: Dualpolis White Party
entries.content: The White Party of Dualpolis is one of the three parliamentary parties in Dualpolis and is currently the most powerful party. The current Prime Minister Watson is from this party. The power of this party comes from its successful union of three types of people: status quo defenders who hate all change, theorists who advocate the smallest possible government and the greatest possible economic and market liberalization, and conservatives who dream of returning to a more "moral" but may less modern way of life.

entries.name: Dualpolis June Party
entries.content: The June Party of Dualpolis is one of the three parliamentary parties in Dualpolis and the oldest party in existence in this country, with a history of over 100 years. Nowadays, their political views are generally centrist, advocating the promotion of social development through political adjustments or limited reforms based on the status quo.

entries.name: Reform Alliance of Dualpolis
entries.content: The Reform Alliance of Dualpolis was founded in 2008. It is the party with the fewest seats among the three parliamentary parties in Dualpolis and has never successfully elected a prime minister. They are generally the most dissatisfied with the status quo. They include social democrats, republicans who dream of ending the monarchy, and oppositionists who criticize previous governments for being too soft on the United States and unable to protect the interests of the people.

entries.name: Latino
entries.content: Forty-five percent of the population of Dualpolis have at least their paternal ancestors from Latin America - especially Mexico - and many of them are also Catholics. Most of them speak both Spanish and English, and the younger generation even speaks English more often.

entries.name: Non-Latino white
entries.content: Dualpolis' population is approximately 21 percent non-Latino white, most of whom speak English.

entries.name: Asian
entries.content: About 15% of Dualpolis' population is of Asian descent, mainly Chinese, Japanese, and Indian descent, who form many communities in the cities of Dualpolis.

entries.name: Indigenous
entries.content:
On Dualpolis Island, about 11% of the population is indigenous. Today, on this island, the term "Indigenous" has almost become synonymous with "Nahuas", and there are still people who master the Nahuatl language. However, in recent years, there have been voices criticizing Dualpolis' indigenous revitalization policy for focusing only on the Nahuas and ignoring the Ohlone civilization that was earlier but conquered by the Nahuas in 15th century.
Compared to the bustling areas of the city, most indigenous people are distributed in suburbs and small towns.

entries.name: African
entries.content: "Africans" are defined by Dualpolis law as people whose ancestors came from African countries other than North Africa. They make up about 5% of the total population of Dualpolis. Almost all Africans in Dualpolis come from the western United States, especially California, and believe in Protestantism.

entries.name: Industry
entries.content: Copper mining, auto parts, natural gas, and leather processing play an important role in the economy of the Grand Duchy of Dualpolis, and they still rely heavily on exporting these products to maintain the richness of food. In addition, Dualpolis also tried to transform its tourism industry in 1990, but it was not very effective due to its lack of competitiveness with neighboring regions - California and Hawaii.

entries.name: Society & Life
entries.content: In the minds of many older Americans, the Duchy of Dualpolis is a mini version of California with low income but complete basic welfare and better public security. However, in recent years, after several recessions and the White Party government has continuously cut public spending budgets, and more and more social problems have been exposed.

entries.name: Relations with the United States
entries.content: After the signing of the Treaty of Nordeste Coast in 1850, Dualpolis became a semi-sovereign state highly influenced by the United States, with its diplomacy almost factually controlled by the United States. In addition, Dualpolis opened a visa-free policy for up to one year to American citizens, which made some opponents criticize that the country had in fact become the next state of the US.

entries.name: Relationship with the EU and Japan
entries.content:
The royal family of the Duchy of Dualpolis comes from the Habsburg family and has close ties with Spain, Germany, and Austria. Through the United States and the Japanese natives of Dualpolis, Dualpolis also has many exchanges with Japan.
In general, exchanges with the European Union and Japan will not offend the United States at least ideologically, so Dualpolis has relatively close cooperation with them, especially in the field of science and technology.

entries.name: Relationship with China
entries.content: Although Dualpolis is considered a protectorate of the United States, it has many ethnic Chinese. Through these people, Dualpolis is able to have certain private exchanges with China. These exchanges are limited, but they are considered "indispensable." In addition, during the historical period of détente between China and the United States, Dualpolis also established diplomatic relations with China, and always maintained a wise silence on issues related to the Chinese government's claims on disputed territories. Overall, Dualpolis' goal is to maintain necessary economic exchanges with China without offending the American allies.

entries.name: Relations with Mexico
entries.content: Mexico, the country southeast to Dualpolis, is the ancestral country of many citizens of Dualpolis. Under the dispatch of the US armed forces, the armies and police of the three countries sometimes carry out some anti-criminal operations. However, due to the constraints of the United States, Dualpolis cannot engage in further government dialogue with Mexico. On the other hand, although Mexican immigrants help fill the basic labor demand, the Dualpolis government does not want to introduce too many Mexicans at one time, so it has set up economic and academic thresholds. In addition, some right-wing elements in Mexico have advocated that Dualpolis Island belongs to Mexico, which has also caused disgust among many people in Dualpolis.

entries.name: Treaty of Nordeste Coast
entries.content: The "Treaty of the Nordeste Coast" was signed in 1850 and stipulated the influence that the United States had in Dualpolis, making Dualpolis a protectorate of the United States.

entries.name: Geography
entries.content: Generally, the shape of Dualpolis Island resembles a vertical ice cream cone, and the geographical areas from north to south include: Vincent County, Montazul Metropolitan City, Fredoroca Natural Park, Novastacio County, Antonio Sea, San Orilla Metropolitan City.

entries.name: The Northern Part
entries.content: In Dualpolis, the "Northern Part" refers to the area north of the Fredoroca Mountains, including Vincent County and Montazul Metropolitan City. Compared to the Southern Part, the Northern Part is mountainous and hilly, with higher rainfall in spring and summer, which nourishes dense forests.

entries.name: The Southern Part
entries.content:
In Dualpolis, the "Southern Part" refers to the area south of the Fredoroca Mountains, including the two large areas of Novastacio County and San Orilla Metropolitan City, as well as the "small Mediterranean" between them - Antonio Sea.
Compared to the Northern Part, the Southern Part has a flatter terrain, a drier and hotter climate, lacks dense forests and presents a large savanna environment. Along the Antonio Sea coast, land desertification is more serious.

entries.name: Vincent County
entries.content:
Vincent County belongs to the "Northern Part" of Dualpolis Island and is also the northernmost district. The county is separated from the Montazul Metropolitan City to its southeast by a narrow Channel, and to its west is the Pacific Ocean. Vincent County is the main copper mining area on Dualpolis Island. The railway runs through the mountains, the roads are winding, and there are a few terraced farms distributed on the hillsides near the settlements.
The settlements in Vincent County include: Nu-Angeles Town, Maderoja Town, Smithville Town, Agalla Town, Clara Town.

entries.name: Nordeste Coast
entries.content: Nordeste Coast is located in the north of Vincent County. In 1850, the United States sent troops to occupy the beaches here and signed a treaty to make it a leased territory. It was not returned to the Dualpolis government until 1991. However, there are still a large number of US troops stationed in and around Nordeste Naval Base, far exceeding the Dualpolis's Military.

entries.name: Nordeste Naval Base
entries.content: Nordeste Naval Base is a developed port where the United States has stationed a large number of troops, far larger than Dualpolis's Military.

entries.name: Nu-Angeles Town
entries.content: Nu-Angeles Town is located southwest of Nordeste Naval Base, about 20 minutes by car. This town was used to house non-combatants during the American Concession period, and today it has become the largest town in Vincent County, almost a small city, and a must-stop for many American cruise ship tourists. It's obviously that the construction and planning of Nu-Angeles Town are imitations of Los Angeles.

entries.name: Barrera Channel
entries.content: The "Barrera Channel" is essentially a long and narrow strait with an average width of three kilometers. Its northwest coast belongs to Vincent County and its southeast coast belongs to the Metropolitan City of Montazul.

entries.name: Agalla Town
entries.content: Agalla Town is located on a peninsula on the east coast of Vincent County, on the west bank of the northern end of the Barrera Channel. As a port town, Agalla receives a large number of ships from the Litora Orisona District of the Metropolitan City of Montazul every day. In addition, the headquarters of the Dualpolis National Guard Maritime Department is also located 25 minutes north of Agalla.

entries.name: Ruidoso River
entries.content: Ruidoso River is a river that flows from northwest to southeast, through Vincent County and into the Barrera Channel.

entries.name: Maderoja Town
entries.content: Maderoja Town is located in the inland river valley area of Vincent County, beside the Ruidoso River. There are large forest areas nearby. It is the main timber production and processing site on Dualpolis Island.

entries.name: Clara Town
entries.content: Clara Town is a settlement located in the southeast of Vincent County, west of the Barrera Channel. It is also the most populous and largest settlement in Vincent County except Nu-Angeles Town. It has Campogorrio International Airport to its west, and the "Twin Bridges" to the east.

entries.name: Campogorrio International Airport
entries.content:
Campogorrio International Airport is located west of Clara Town. It is one of the two international airports on Dualpolis Island. It takes about 15 minutes by car to get to the nearest Clara Town. It takes 30 minutes to drive east from the airport to Pedrafredo Town, which is affiliated to the Montazul Metropolitan City. Alternatively, you can take a 40-minute train line to Pinonevado Zero Station in Montazul City.
Campogorrio International Airport was built in 1943. It was originally built to assist US military operations and as a facility for American instructors to train Dualpolis pilots. It was converted into a civilian airport after the end of World War II.

entries.name: Montazul Metropolitan City
entries.content:
Montazul Metropolitan City is the capital of Dualpolis. It belongs to the "Northern Part" of Dualpolis Island and has the highest urbanization rate and the most extensive railway system on the island. Montazul Metropolitan City is bordered by Fredoroca Natural Park to the south, Vincent County to the west by the Barrera Channel, and the Pacific Ocean to the east and north. In Montazul, the rigor of business elites coexists with the vitality of freedom and openness. Montazul is also the only settlement in Dualpolis with a higher Asian population than the national average.
The city has 9 affiliated districts: Teraderecho, Kopillo, Pinonevado, Paloma, Tapiton, Litora Orisona, Terintero, Pedrafredo Town, and Jacob Town.

entries.name: Montazul Railway
entries.content:
The mountainous terrain and narrow neighborhoods of the Metropolitan City of Montazul result in a lack of roads suitable for cars, but fortunately, they have an extensive rail network that is sufficient to meet almost all commuting needs in the city - if you accept "occasional" congestion and delays.
Among all the stations, Pinonevado Zero Station in Pinonevado District is the central hub for all lines.

entries.name: Teraderecho District
entries.content:
Teraderecho District is one of the subordinate areas of Montazul Metropolitan City. It was historically located in the center of Montazul, but with the expansion of Montazul City, it has now become a relatively eastern area.
Teraderecho borders Pinonevado to the southwest, Paloma to the northwest, the Pacific sea to the northeast, and Kopillo to the southeast.
Currently, the average land rent in Teraderecho District is the highest in Dualpolis, with offices of large companies, headquarters of government departments, luxury commercial streets, and high-end apartments - Especially in the Dionysus Street.

entries.name: Dionysus Street
entries.content: Dionysus Street is an upscale commercial area located in Teraderecho District, Montazul City. It is home to the most upscale shops, restaurants and entertainment venues in the entire island of Dualpolis, and is always filled with a luxurious atmosphere.

entries.name: Guinda Palace
entries.content: Guinda Palace is located in Teraderecho District of Montazul Metropolitan City. It is the residence of the Grand Duke of Dualpolis. There are many cherry trees planted in the garden. About 1 km north of this palace is the Dualpolis Parliament.

entries.name: Caballero Molino Theatre
entries.content: Caballero Molino Theatre is a large theater located at the junction of Pinonevado District and Teraderecho District in Montazul City. It is the theater with the best facilities and the largest venue on Dualpolis Island.

entries.name: Pinonevado District
entries.content:
Pinonevado is a district in the Montazul Metropolitan City. It borders Jacob Town to the south, Terintero to the west, Paloma to the north, and Teraderecho to the northeast.
Pinonevado is the most prosperous and busy district in the Metropolitan City of Montazul today. Whether it is ordinary people or rich people, whether it is tourists or workers, they will never feel bored. Many shops have their headquarters here, and many small and medium-sized enterprises also have offices here.

entries.name: Pinonevado Zero Station
entries.content: Pinonevado Zero Station is the railway hub of the entire Montazul Metropolitan City, where all the city's lines intersect. From this station, you can take a westward special line to Campogorrio International Airport in about 40 minutes.

entries.name: Terintero District
entries.content:
Terintero District is the geographical center of the Metropolitan City of Montazul. It was once a railway town. Terintero borders Jacob Town to the south, Tapiton to the southwest, Litora Orisona to the west, Paloma to the north, and Pinonevado to the east.
Due to its reasonable rent and convenient transportation, Terintero has facilities that can meet all the needs of a person, as well as many affordable shops, which attracts many single young people in their twenties and thirties to live there.

entries.name: Dualpolis National University
entries.content: Dualpolis National University, or simply "DNU" is the only public university and the only comprehensive university on Dualpolis Island. The university has four campuses. The oldest and main campus is located in Terintero District and was established in 1919. The second campus is located in Pedrafredo Town and was established in 1962. The third campus is located in San Orilla City at the southern end of Dualpolis Island. The newest campus is located in Paloma District and was built in 2007.

entries.name: Paloma District
entries.content:
Paloma District is the northernmost district in the Metropolitan City of Montazul. It borders Terintero, Pinonevado and Teraderecho from west to east in the south, Litora Orisona in the southwest, and a coastal road through hilly woodlands in the north.
Paloma was once prosperous in the 1980s, but today it faces an aging population crisis and is trying to transform itself into a university town serving the fourth campus of Dualpolis National University. In addition, Paloma is also a gathering place for many foreign students in the city of Montazul.

entries.name: Mohandas Street
entries.content:
"Mohandas Street" is an Indian community located at the junction of Paloma District and Pinonevado in the Montazul Metropolitan City. It is worth noting that among the local Indian immigrants, more than half are from Gujarat.
In addition, the main telecommunications service operator on Dualpolis Island also has its headquarters near this street.

entries.name: Kabutara Mosque
entries.content: The Kabutara Mosque is located in Paloma District and is the only mosque on Dualpolis Island. Some small communities of Muslim immigrants, mainly from Pakistan and Iran, has formed around this Pakistani-style building.

entries.name: Litora Orisona District
entries.content:
Litora Orisona is a district in the Metropolitan Municipality of Montazul, covering half of the southeastern coast of the Barrera Channel, while the northwest coast belongs to Vincent County. The southern part of the district is industrial, and the northern corner has a busy port with a large number of ships traveling to and from Agalla Town in Vincent County.
The following districts border Litora Orisona: Tapiton to the south, Pedrafredo Town to the southwest, Paloma to the northeast, and Terintero to the east.

entries.name: Montazul Pandatown
entries.content:
Montazul Pandatown is a Chinese community located at the junction of the three districts of Litora Orisona, Paloma and Terintero. This is the oldest Asian community on Dualpolis Island, which was formed in the 1890s.
From Montazul Pandatown, it is only a 10-minute drive to the fourth campus of Dualpolis National University. There are many rental houses nearby for students, which are operated by Chinese companies in Montazul Pandatown.

entries.name: Litora Detroit
entries.content: Litora Detroit is an area located in the Litora Orisona District. It is the largest auto parts production base on Dualpolis Island and manufactures for many foreign brands.

entries.name: Pedrafredo Town
entries.content:
Pedrafredo Town is part of the Metropolitan Municipality of Montazul and is located near the southern end of the Barrera Channel. Pedrafredo Station is the only intermediate stop on the dedicated rail line between Campogorrio International Airport and Pinonevado Zero Station. In addition, the town is home to the second campus of the Dualpolis National University.
Pedrafredo Town is bordered by Fredoroca Natural Park to the south, Clara Town in Vincent County across the "Twin Bridges" to the west, Litora Orisona to the north, and Tapiton to the east.

entries.name: The Twin Bridges
entries.content: The "Twin Bridges" are two adjacent bridges with an average length of about 2,500 meters, spanning the narrowest part of the southern end of the Barrera Channel, connecting the Clara Town of Vincent County with the Pedrafredo Town of Montazul Metropolitan City, and are the two longest bridges on Dualpolis Island. The two bridges were built in 1985, each integrating a car lane and a train lane, and are an imitation of the Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco in terms of aesthetics.

entries.name: Tapiton District
entries.content: Tapiton is a district in the Metropolitan Municipality of Montazul, with low housing prices, second only to those settlements called "towns". It is bordered by Fredoroca Natural Park to the south, Pedrafredo Town to the west, Litora Orisona to the northwest, Terintero to the northeast, and Jacob Town to the southeast.

entries.name: Kopillo District
entries.content:
Kopillo is a district in the metropolitan city of Montazul, located in the southeastern part of the city. Kopillo borders Fredoroca Natural Park to the south, Jacob Town to the southwest, Teraderecho to the northwest, and mountains by the sea to the northeast.
Although Kopillo District is close to the sea, it is mountainous and lacks the conditions for opening a port. However, due to its beautiful natural environment and complete infrastructure, Kopillo has received investment from many real estate developers, who have built it into a villa area for the rich.

entries.name: Dualpolis National Museum
entries.content:
The Dualpolis National Museum is a landmark of the Kopillo District. It is located in the south of the Kopillo District, near a railway station that enters the scenic spots of the Fredoroca Natural Park.
The Dualpolis National Museum is a two-story building with a futuristic design and a spherical observatory on top.

entries.name: Jacob Town
entries.content:
Jacob Town is part of the Montazul Metropolitan Municipality. The town is near the largest and oldest copper mine on Dualpolis Island.
Jacob Town borders the following areas: Fredoroca Natural Park to the south, Tapiton to the northwest, Terintero and Pinonevado to the north, and Kopillo to the east.

entries.name: Cathedral of San Juan
entries.content: The Cathedral of San Juan is a Catholic church that is the most important religious center for Catholics in the Metropolitan City of Montazul and even the entire island of Dualpolis. The church is designed in traditional Mexican style and is located in the middle of the slope of San Juan Mountain at the junction of Jacob Town and Kopillo District.

entries.name: Fredoroca Natural Park
entries.content: Fredoroca Natural Park is a transverse mountain forest, named after the Mont Fredoroca. It borders Novastacio County and the San Orilla Metropolitan City to the south and the Montazul Metropolitan City to the north. As a nature reserve, it is sparsely populated. There are no settlements in Fredoroca Natural Park except for military camps and scattered Trailer Parks and climber camps.

entries.name: Mont Fredoroca
entries.content:
Mont Fredoroca is located in the west of the central part of Fredoroca Natural Park. It is the highest mountain in the entire Dualpolis Island. Mont Fredoroca became an extinct volcano in the 9th century, and the accumulated water formed Kuautiatl Lake on the top of the mountain.
Looking south from the top of Mont Fredoroca, you can see the "small Mediterranean" between Novastacio County and San Orilla Metropolitan City - Antonio Sea. If the weather is good, you may also see Steven Dam on the Passaro River.

entries.name: Kuautiatl Lake
entries.content: Kuautiatl Lake was formed in the 9th century when Mont Fredoroca became an extinct volcano. In the tradition of the Aboriginal people, this lake has a sacred status.

entries.name: The Old Tepealtepetl
entries.content: The area south of Mont Fredoroca to Antonio Sea was once the core area of the local Nahua civilization. After the Spanish colonists arrived, they destroyed those towns and forced the indigenous people to migrate. The Old Tepealtepetl is the best-preserved ancient indigenous building complex site to date. It is located at the southern end of Fredoroca Natural Park. Today, the nearest settlement is Sutter Town, which belongs to San Orilla Metropolitan City, about a 30-minute drive away.

entries.name: Novastacio County
entries.content:
Novastacio County belongs to the "Southern Part" of Dualpolis Island. It is a piece of land that is approximately an inverted triangle and is located in the northwest of the Southern Part. Generally speaking, the southeast of Novadtacio is San Orilla Metropolitan City, and the inner lake "Antonio Sea" is sandwiched between the two places. The Pacific Ocean is to the west of Novastacio County, and Fredoroca Natural Park is to the north.
Settlements in Novastacio County include: Nova Gibraltar Town, Manzana Blanca Town, Samuel Town, Pescador Town, Kaiser Island.

entries.name: Novastacio Military Base
entries.content: The Novastacio Military Base is located in Novastacio County and is the base of the main force of the Guardia Nacional de Dualpolis' land division. It is close to Fredoroca Natural Park to its north and is about a 20-minute drive from the nearest settlement, Manzana Blanca Town, via the highway to its south.

entries.name: Samuel Town
entries.content: Samuel Town is located in the heart of Novastacio County and is named after the Samuel River. It is the agricultural and livestock center of Dualpolis. There is also an industrial park that integrates crop-animal product processing 15 minutes away by car.

entries.name: Nova Gibraltar Town
entries.content: Nova Gibraltar Town is located at the southernmost tip of Novastacio County, separated from Passaro Town of San Orilla Metropolitan City by the Passaro River to the south and the Antonio Sea to the east. Most of the land in Nova Gibraltar Town is desert, and has the Steven Dam's northern part that located in its suburbs.

entries.name: Antonio Sea
entries.content: The Antonio Sea is a "little Mediterranean" sandwiched between Novastacio County and San Orilla Metropolitan City. It is surrounded by sand and the water is seawater with marine life. The only entrance and exit to this area is the Passaro River. Since the construction of Steven Dam across the Passaro River in 2000, the water level of the Antonio Sea has dropped.

entries.name: Steven Dam
entries.content: Steven Dam was designed by Japanese architect Steven Kazuya Kikuchi and started construction in 1988 and was completed in 1999. The dam is 1,100 meters long and 64 meters high, built on the Passaro River, the only outlet of the Antonio Sea. Supporters always emphasize the contribution of the dam as a power station, while critics say it has caused the disorder of the Antonio Sea and made Novastacio County and San Orilla Metropolitan City more arid.

entries.name: Kaiser Island
entries.content: Kaiser Island is a small island located in the Pacific Ocean northwest of Novastacio County, 2 kilometers away from the nearest coast of Novastacio County. The island once produced nitrite, and workers built a village on the island. However, after the nitrite was exhausted in the 1980s and the nitrite factory stopped operating, the population of the village became smaller and smaller, and today almost only the last elderly people are left.

entries.name: San Orilla Metropolitan City
entries.content:
San Orilla Metropolitan City belongs to the "Southern Part" of Dualpolis Island and is the southernmost district on the island. It is surrounded by the Pacific Ocean to the southwest and east, Antonio Sea and Novastacio County to the northwest, and Montazul Metropolitan City can be reached by following the road and tunnel to the north through Fredoroca Natural Park. The nearest foreign city to San Orilla Metropolitan City is San Diego in the United States, which is about 1,000 kilometers northeast of San Orilla.
Although it is not the capital, San Orilla has a larger population density than Montazul City and is more ethnically diverse. It is generally believed that the atmosphere of this city is more relaxing than that of Montazul City.
The following areas are included in the scope of San Orilla Metropolitan City: Centro District, Hermano Bueno District, Suaviladera District, Uvamorada District, Doradarena District, Palmera District, Las Cuarzo District, Campaldeano District, Sutter Town, Passaro Town, Teraverde Town.

entries.name: Sutter Town
entries.content: Sutter Town is located at the junction of San Orilla City, Novastacio County and Fredoroca Natural Park. There is a small beach on the south side of Sutter Town, which borders the Antonio Sea, the north side borders the Fredoroca Mountains, and the southeast side has a highway leading to the Las Cuarzo District. Sutter Town was once a coal mining area, but in the 1990s, the local coal mines gradually dried up and transformed into an agricultural area. Due to its proximity to the Old Tepealtepetl ruins, Aztec-themed sightseeing and entertainment projects and souvenir shops are also a major feature of Sutter Town.

entries.name: Las Cuarzo District
entries.content:
Las Cuarzo is a district in San Orilla Metropolitan City, which is approximately a horizontal rectangular piece of land. Las Cuarzo borders Uvamorada to the south, a small beach to the southwest borders Antonio Sea, the northwest direction is along the highway to Sutter Town, and it borders Fredoroca Natural Park to the north. Bahia Celestial Marina belongs to its east to the Pacific Ocean.
Las Cuarzo is located in a high-lying area within San Orilla Metropolitan City, and it is also the place with the highest greening rate in San Orilla City. Many upper-class people live in luxurious villas here.

entries.name: Bahia Celestial Marina
entries.content: Bahia Celestial Marina is located on the coast of the Pacific Ocean on the east side of Las Cuarzo District. It is actually a place where the wealthy people living in the area park their yachts, luxury cars and helicopters. It is also the headquarters of companies operating yacht and private jet businesses.

entries.name: Mont Chris Art Gallery
entries.content: The Nu-Milenio Academy's art gallery is also called the Mont Chris Art Gallery. It is located on the Mont Chris highlands in the Las Cuarzo District. It was a castle built by the Spanish in the colonial era, with a watchtower in the center. The top of the watchtower has a wide view, and you can see the city of San Orilla, Antonio Sea and Novastacio County. When the weather is good, you can even observe the details of Steven Dam on the Passaro River through a telescope.

entries.name: Uvamorada District
entries.content: Uvamorada is a district within the city of San Orilla, bordering Centro District to the south, Suaviladera to the southwest, the sandy land bordering Antonio Sea to the west, Sutter Town via the highway to the northwest, Las Cuarzo District to the north, and the Pacific Ocean to the east.

entries.name: Nu-Milenio Academy of Music and Fine Arts
entries.content: Nu-Milenio Academy of Music and Fine Arts was established in 1984 and is located at the junction of Uvamorada District and Las Cuarzo District. It is the only higher education institution specializing in art education on the island of Dualpolis. As a private art school, Nu-Milenio is the most expensive educational institution on Dualpolis Island. However, it has indeed trained many well-known local artists, actors and designers.

entries.name: Hoja Octo Cinema
entries.content: Hoja Octo Cinema is a landmark building in Hoja Octo Street, Uvamorada District. It is the largest, most seated and best equipped cinema on Dualpolis Island. It also has a basement that can be used for small-scale theatrical performances.

entries.name: Hoja Octo Street
entries.content: Hoja Octo Street is named after Hoja Octo Cinema. It is part of the boundary between Uvamorada District and Centro District and is close to Antonio Sea. This street is known as the youngest, most fashionable and most vibrant place in San Orilla City. It is home to a large number of art design studios, hobby shops, comics and game disc stores. Whether it is fans dressed as virtual characters in animations or games, or bands or network anchors performing flash mobs, it is not uncommon to see them on this street.

entries.name: Centro District
entries.content: Centro District was once the site of the Spanish and Mexican armies during the colonial era, and is now the site of San Orilla City Hall. Centro District borders Campaldeano to the southwest, Suaviladera to the west, Uvamorada to the north, and the Pacific Ocean to the east.

entries.name: Pacifica Seaside Park
entries.content: Pacifica Seaside Park is one of the landmarks of San Orilla City. It is located on the north side of the coastline facing the Pacific Ocean east of the Centro District. This park not only has a scenic beach, but also the largest oceanarium and amusement park on Dualpolis Island.

entries.name: Suaviladera District
entries.content: Suaviladera is a district in the city of San Orilla, bordering Campaldeano District to the south, Palmera District to the west, Antonio Sea to the northwest, Suaviladera to the northeast, and Centro District to the east. Suaviladera District has the largest marina along the Antonio Sea.

entries.name: Suaviladera Dock Area
entries.content: Suaviladera Dock Area is located in the northwest of Suaviladera, on the shore of Antonio Sea. It used to be a fishing village, but today it is the largest port along the Antonio Sea, with many seafood restaurants and markets selling fishermen's or factory direct sales products.

entries.name: “Archipielago Vacacional” the Cruise
entries.content: The "Archipielago Vacacional" was once an American ocean liner, which was later bought by a French descent businessman from Dualpolis and converted into a floating hotel and French seafood restaurant. Generally, it is always moored at the Suaviladera Dock Area, but sometimes it also takes a short sightseeing route to other ports along the Antonio Sea.

entries.name: Kosaka
entries.content: Kosaka is an Asian community located in Suaviladera District. Seventy percent of the population is Japanese, and there are also small communities of Korean, Hawaiian or Southeast Asian immigrants.

entries.name: Michimoto Temple
entries.content: Michimoto Temple is a Buddhist temple in Kosaka, a typical Japanese building with a courtyard. The temple is an important community center in Kosaka. In addition, they also operate a school nearby that adopts the "Japanese-style education concept". It has not only been certified by the education department of Dualpolis Duchy to provide elementary and secondary education and issue corresponding diplomas, but also provides extra Japanese language courses.

entries.name: Palmera District
entries.content: Palmera District is a district within the municipality of San Orilla, bordering the Pacific Ocean to the south, Teraverde Town to the southwest, Doradarena District to the west, Passaro Town to the northwest, a small bay belonging to the Antonio Sea called Hermes Bay to the north, and Palmera to the northeast, Suaviladera, Campaldeano District to the east, and Hermano Bueno District to the southeast.

entries.name: Hermes Bay
entries.content: Hermes Bay is a small bay located in the north of Palmera District and is part of the Antonio Sea. It is known as the most beautiful beach on the entire Dualpolis Island, with clean, perfect light yellow sand and large and coordinated palm trees on the beach. Along the roadside of the beach, there are hotels, shops, Mexican-style bars and restaurants.

entries.name: "El Anillo del Senor" Super Arena
entries.content:
"El Anillo del Senor", or El Anillo for short, is a Super Arena located at the junction of the three districts of Palmera, Suaviladera and Campaldeano. This building is one of the landmarks of San Orilla City. It was built in 1997 and designed by a team of local artists and architects, incorporating many avant-garde aesthetic concepts.
El Anillo del Senor is the arena with the best facilities, the largest venue and the most seats on Dualpolis Island. In addition to sports events, its facilities are also complete and advanced enough to host various large-scale performances.

entries.name: Campaldeano District
entries.content:
Campaldeano District, used to be called as "Hermano Bueno County", now is a district in San Orilla City, and it is also the only district in San Orilla City that is not close to the sea. Campaldeano borders Hermano Bueno to the south, Palmera to the west, Suaviladera to the north, and Centro District to the northeast.
Campaldeano District is the last place to be developed in San Orilla City. The further south you go, the less high-rise buildings and huge buildings there are. It is like a rural area but has dense old houses and was stuffed into San Orilla City. However, the average rent here is not expensive, and it is close to the bustling area, which also attracts many young working class to live there.

entries.name: The San Orilla Campus of Dualpolis National University
entries.content: The San Orilla Campus is the third campus of the Dualpolis National University, which was established in 1994 and is located in the northeastern end of the Campaldeano District, San Orilla City - for the convenience of students from the city of San Orilla. This campus includes most of the courses offered by the other campuses of the Dualpolis National University, although the educational resources are generally considered not as good as the branch in Montazul City.

entries.name: Hermano Bueno District
entries.content:
Hermano Bueno District, used to be called as "Hermano Bueno County", is now a district in San Orilla. The district is shaped like a right triangle with the hypotenuse on the left. It is adjacent to the sea in the south, a small area bordering Palmera in the southwest corner, Campaldeano in the northwest, and the Pacific Ocean in the east.
Like Campaldeano, Hermano Bueno District was developed after the construction of Victoria International Airport. However, since Hermano Bueno is close to the sea and directly operates Victoria International Airport, it does not look as rural as Campaldeano District today.

entries.name: The former "Hermano Bueno County"
entries.content:
"Hermano Bueno County" was an administrative division that existed before the 1960s and included the districts of Campaldeano and Hermano Bueno, which are now part of San Orilla Metropolitan City, as well as some areas in the southern part of Palmera District. The County was abolished after Campaldeano and Hermano Bueno were incorporated into the City of San Orilla.
Campaldeano District and Hermano Bueno District were part of Hermano Bueno County before the 1960s and were an underdeveloped savanna with only a few scattered villages. In the 1960s, during the construction of Victoria International Airport, the Dualpolis government launched large-scale infrastructure projects in Campaldeano and Hermano Bueno, and many workers settled in these two places. As the population density increased and the complex gradually bordered the city of San Orilla, Campaldeano and Hermano Bueno were finally assigned to San Orilla Metropolitan City.

entries.name: Victoria International Airport
entries.content: Victoria International Airport is located near the port area on the east coast of Hermano Bueno District. It is the second international airport in Dualpolis. It was completed in 1968 and flights were put into use the following year. Before the airport was built, Victoria was the name of a local dock town. The airport has a dedicated railway line that can reach the main station in Centro District in as fast as 30 minutes.

entries.name: Passaro Town
entries.content:
Passaro Town is a settlement southwest of the Antonio Sea. It was once part of Novastacio County and was reassigned to San Orilla Metropolitan City in 1978. Passaro town is named after the Passaro River.
Passaro Town borders Doradarena District to the south, the Pacific Ocean to the west, and Nova Gibraltar Town in Novastacio County to the north across the Passaro River. Passaro Town borders the Antonio Sea to the northeast, and a small area to the southeast borders the Palmera District.
Passaro Town is also the location of the southern end of Steven Dam.

entries.name: Passaro River
entries.content: Passaro River is the water connecting Antonio Sea to the Pacific Ocean. The south bank of the river belongs to Passaro Town in San Orilla Metropolitan City, and the north bank belongs to Nova Gibraltar Town in Novastacio County. Steven Dam crosses the river from north to south.

entries.name: Doradarena District
entries.content:
Doradarena District is the westernmost place called a "district" in San Orilla Metropolitan City. The district is shaped like a vertical rectangle, bordering Teraverde Town to the south, the Pacific Ocean to the west, Passaro Town to the north, and Palmera District to the east.
Doradarena District was once called Doradarena Town, which belonged to Novastacio County at that time. In 1978, Doradarena Town was reassigned to San Orilla Metropolitan City. With the advancement of urbanization, it was renamed Doradarena District in 1995.
Although it is far away from the center of San Orilla Metropolitan City, the summer here is not as hot as other districts in San Orilla Metropolitan City. In addition, there are highways and railways that can reach Centro District within an hour. Doradarena is favored by many middle-class people.

entries.name: Teraverde Town
entries.content:
Teraverde Town is the southernmost part of Dualpolis Island. It used to belong to Novastacio County, but was reassigned to San Orilla Metropolitan City in 1978.
Teraverde is a peninsula, bordering the Pacific Ocean to the south, west and east, Doradarena District to the north, and Palmera District to the northeast.
Teraverde has the only naturally formed green forest in San Orilla Metropolitan City. It is a favorite holiday destination, especially a scenic spot called Floracio Valley.

entries.name: Floracio Valley
entries.content: Floracio Valley is located on the southernmost coast of Teraverde Town. It is named after the nearby Floracio Mountain. Floracio is a dormant volcano. Thanks to its geothermal resources, Floracio Valley has many hot springs. At the same time, unlike other areas in San Orilla City, it is not dry, but has a unique naturally formed forest landscape. This is why many hot spring-themed attractions and resorts have been opened here.
